title: Front-row seat at the JSNation keynote
description: The best seat in the house for the opening keynote. Close enough to read the speaker notes, far enough to avoid the confetti cannon.

title: Mystery box from the Supabase swag closet
description: Nobody knows what is in it. Possibly stickers. Possibly a hoodie. Possibly more stickers.

title: A rubber duck that has seen production
description: Retired after six years of on-call. Has heard every explanation of every outage. Still won't tell you it was DNS, but it knows.

title: A first edition of JavaScript: The Good Parts
description: Mint condition, barely opened. It's a quick read: you'll finish it before the closing party, and still have time for the other parts.

title: Vintage jQuery plugin, mint condition
description: A carousel from 2011, never minified. Comes with its original README and a handwritten note that says works in IE6.

title: Lifetime supply of node_modules
description: Ships in forty boxes. Delivery takes about as long as a fresh install on conference Wi-Fi.
